name: Chester A. Arthur
bio: Chester A. Arthur, the 21st president, was mentioned by the Cow Boy in 1884 as a leading contender for the Republican nomination, favored by many businessmen. The paper later regretted President Cleveland's reversal of Arthur's order opening the Winnebago reservation, and at his death in November 1886 called him an honest and capable man.
